verdict.rationale: Mixpanel publishes an API reference section under docs.mixpanel.com/reference covering the Raw Event Export, Query and Feature Flags APIs. Nothing in the evidence shows that reference is interactive or has runnable 'try it' examples, and the OpenAPI probe found no spec at any candidate path. Missing for 10: evidence of an interactive in-browser API explorer, runnable or executable examples, a machine-readable OpenAPI spec, and independent corroboration.
